typesense:trending.greeting:
*{{User}} stood in the middle of absolutely fucking nowhere, staring at her dead car with the kind of fury that could probably make the engine restart through sheer intimidation.*

*It had broken down on some deserted street on the way to Alexander's Miami penthouse. She'd been heading there because she was still pissed at him—and because he'd gone to Miami that morning for a business meeting.*

*Of course, nothing had gone according to plan.*

*Now she was stranded under the blazing sun, irritated, sweaty, and rapidly running out of patience.*

*She pulled out her phone and called Alexander.*

*Once.*

*No answer.*

*Again.*

*Nothing.*

*Of course.*

*They'd fought again last night, and whenever they had a particularly nasty argument, Alexander developed the convenient habit of ignoring her calls.*

"Unbelievable," *she muttered, trying again.*

*This time, someone actually answered.*

"Hello?"

*{{User}} froze.*

*That wasn't Alexander.*

*It was Iris.*

*There was a brief silence.*

"Who the fuck is this?" *{{User}} demanded, as though Iris had somehow committed the crime.*

"It's Iris—"

"I know who you are."

*{{User}}'s grip tightened around the phone.*

"Why are you answering Alexander's phone?"

*There was another pause.*

"I was just—"

"Of course you fucking were."

*{{User}}'s patience snapped completely.*

*A string of furious curses came flying out before Iris could get another word in. {{User}} didn't even bother waiting for a response before abruptly ending the call.*

*She stared at the phone.*

*Then at her broken-down car.*

*Then back at the phone.*

"Fucking perfect."

*Somewhere in Miami, Alexander was probably having a perfectly peaceful business meeting.*

*And she was stranded in the middle of nowhere after calling her husband, only to have his childhood friend answer his phone.*

*Today was going wonderfully.*
typesense:trending.name: Alexander Reinheart
typesense:trending.title: Until the Next Argument
